这里是木柴。气体网格不测量木头内部的温度。: This is wood. The gas grid does not measure temperature inside the wood.
周围的空气。燃料很少，几乎没有燃烧放热。: Surrounding air. Little fuel and almost no combustion heating.
这里正在燃烧，但烟炱很少。蓝光不需要炽热的烟炱。: Combustion is active here, with little soot. Blue light does not need incandescent soot.
燃料和空气在这里相遇，反应正在释放热量。: Fuel meets air here, and reactions release heat.
这里燃料较多、可用空气少，燃烧受到供氧限制。: Fuel is abundant and available air is scarce. Oxygen supply limits combustion.
这里的烟炱正在发光。亮度还取决于颗粒多少和视线厚度。: Hot soot glows here. Brightness also depends on particle abundance and optical depth.
热气仍在流动，但这里的燃烧放热已较弱。: Hot gas is still moving, but local combustion heating is weak.
气体正在与周围空气混合、冷却。: Gas is mixing with the surrounding air and cooling.
拖动旋转，滚动或双指缩放。火焰、木柴、烟和火星都在同一个三维空间里。: Drag to orbit; scroll or pinch to zoom. Flames, logs, smoke and sparks share one three-dimensional space.
剖面颜色是温度，不是火焰原来的颜色。点一下剖面，读出这一点有多热。: The section colors encode temperature, not the natural color of fire. Tap the section to measure a point.
暂停后留下一个对照点，再点另一个位置。一起比较温度和烟炱；实景亮光是整条视线的叠: Pause and save a comparison point, then tap another location. Compare temperature and soot together; natural brightness combines light along the whole line of sight.
篝火三维场景；拖动旋转，方向键转动，加减键缩放: 3D campfire; drag or use arrow keys to orbit, plus and minus to zoom
换 Chrome / Edge / Safari 26 可以玩实时的火；也需要设: Try Chrome, Edge or Safari 26 for live fire; your device must also support the required WebGPU features.
录像不能读出实时温度。黄色来自发光的烟炱，蓝色包含化学发光；颜色不能单独当温度计: A recording has no live probe readings. Yellow light comes from glowing soot; blue includes chemiluminescence. Color alone is not a thermometer.
循环视频暂时未能加载，正在显示静态预览。: The loop could not load. Showing a still preview.
点剖面上的任何位置，看看那里有多热。: Tap anywhere on the section to see how hot it is.
这些数是怎么来的？: Where do these numbers come from?
温度、燃料、烟炱和速度来自这团火的网格。点测使用相邻网格的插值，木柴内部不提供气: Temperature, fuel, soot and velocity come from this fire's grid. Probes interpolate neighboring cells; readings inside solid wood are withheld.
可用空气 = 1 − 燃料 − 产物与惰性气体。它不是氧气浓度；若假设新鲜空气中: Available air = 1 minus fuel minus products and inert gas. It is not oxygen concentration. Assuming 23.2% oxygen by mass in fresh air gives an estimated oxygen mass fraction.
放热图显示燃烧引起的升温率，单位 K/s，不是温度，也不是整团火的 kW。气体会: The heat-release map shows combustion heating in K/s, not temperature or whole-fire kW. Radiation and mixing cool the gas at the same time.
蓝光是放热驱动的化学发光近似；模型没有逐个求解 CH*、C₂*、OH 或 CO₂: Blue light approximates chemiluminescence driven by heating. The model does not resolve CH*, C2*, OH or CO2 molecules. Color and brightness undergo camera-like processing.
剖面是一个位置的原始模拟场；实景是整条视线的光叠加，并加了细节噪声。两种颜色不能: The section samples raw fields at one location. The natural view combines light along each ray and adds detail noise. Their colors do not represent the same per-pixel quantity.
热解气从固定的木柴表面供给。模型没有木柴内部传热、消耗、水或分子扩散，不能直接当: Fixed log surfaces supply pyrolysis gas. Internal wood heating, fuel depletion, water and molecular diffusion are absent, so this is not an extinction or microgravity predictor.
涡量由投影前的速度差分换算；它和最终速度的采样时刻相差一个求解步骤。: Vorticity is converted from pre-projection velocity differences, one solver stage earlier than the final velocity.
